# Next.js + Auth

Next.js with **[@robojs/auth](/docs/plugins/auth)** and Prisma for authentication.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/plugins/auth" title="@robojs/auth" description="Authentication plugin." />
  <Card href="https://www.prisma.io/" title="Prisma" description="Database ORM." />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template web-apps/next-auth-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure your database in `.env`:

```bash
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/myapp"
```

Run migrations:

```bash
npx prisma migrate dev
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Discord OAuth authentication
- Session management
- User database with Prisma
- Protected routes
